facts: Mobium has no driver for KaiOS of its own: the built-in backends are UiAutomator2 and uiautomator for Android, and WebDriverAgent for iOS simulators, iPhones and the Apple TV simulator.
A platform Mobium does not drive itself is reached through a driver: an executable named mobium-driver-<name> on the PATH, in any language, speaking JSON-RPC on stdio.

A driver needs snapshot, screenshot and tap to be useful, and inherits locators, refs, waiting, scrolling, the CLI, MCP and all five clients; examples/drivers/ has the guide and a reference driver in Python.
note: KaiOS is not Android (Gecko-based), so the Android backends cannot reach it; by q058's pattern, kind fact, gold README.md#drivers-for-other-platforms. Stored answer ('runs on Android phones, docs do not mention KaiOS') is fair.
ask: Apply the Tizen ruling to KaiOS (no driver from mobiumdev, anyone can write one), or keep it unanswerable?
